svg.desc: Wide Frutiger Metro vector wallpaper, 2000s pop design. On the left third, a stylish adult woman standing in profile as a single solid deep teal silhouette, clearly defined face, long ponytail, natural proportions and elegant flowing dress. Curving vines, leaves, simple flowers and overlapping circular forms grow around her. Flat solid palette: turquoise, lime, yellow, teal and pale mint. Clean smooth shapes with crisp boundaries, no texture. Leave the right two-thirds uncluttered pale mint for application content. Full bleed; no text, logos, borders or UI elements.
